canonical_reference_order.expected_title: 大众 途昂 2017款 330TSI 两驱豪华版
why_id3_included: S10 parser uses target brand plus vehicle-title shape and does not stop at more-cars boundary.
Canonical order is built from all complete cards before strict target title filtering.
ID.3 price 8.78万 is lower than Tuang 10.89万 and 11.79万, so it becomes canonical reference_index=1.

reliable_s10_gate.conclusion: The current reliable S10 gate excludes report/detail pages, but does not prove that parsed cards are still inside the target trisame pool.

reason_chain: The first Tuang reference was not completed as an effective S14/S15 result, so retrying reference_index=1 is reasonable.
The live S10 XML contains two real Tuang trisame cars and the downstream more-cars section in the same viewport.
The reliable S10 gate passes because the page has price low-to-high and parseable cards with no report-page signals.
The S10 parser includes ID.3 from the more-cars section as a complete card.
Canonical ordering sorts ID.3 before the two Tuang cars due to its lower price.
The post-selection title hard gate blocks with REFERENCE_CARD_TITLE_MISMATCH, preventing ID.3 from being collected.
